message.reasoning:
The user wants us to create a blue background square painting size 16x16 inches and then set screen brightness at 70% for duration? They want to show it for 30 seconds.

We need to call functions accordingly:

1) painting_create shape "square", background_color "blue" dimensions [16,16].
2) display_set_screen_brightness percentage=70 duration maybe 30 (since they say show 30 sec). But we also have painting_display which displays painting for some time; but if we already set brightness for 30s, do we still use painting_display? The instruction says "then display at 70% brightness for 30 seconds". So likely we should first set brightness, then paint display for 30 secs. Or combine both? We can just call painting_display after setting brightness.

Thus sequence:
painting_create -> store result id?
Then display_set_screen_brightness(percentage=70,duration=30)
Then painting_display(time=30)

But note: painting_display expects time param only. It might not require brightness settings. We'll follow instructions.
